name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez's journey into motorsport began in her father's auto repair shop in Guadalajara, where she spent countless hours tinkering with engines and absorbing everything she could about automotive mechanics. Her fascination with speed and precision led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, she started her career in a small local racing team, quickly proving her ability to analyze data, diagnose issues, and implement effective solutions under pressure.

Sofia's approach to race engineering is rooted in a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and a relentless pursuit of improvement. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their expertise. Known for her innovative problem-solving skills and her ability to anticipate potential issues before they arise, Sofia is always pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the track. Her experience with Sprint V8 Team has solidified her reputation as a reliable and insightful engineer, respected for her dedication and her calm demeanor in high-stress situations.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Sofia has a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense air about her.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Mexican coffee before every race.
